text.style: font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 8.5px; fill: rgb(108, 117, 125); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Rows keep one order in every panel, best average performance first. Ours is the mean over 3 seeds, its bar ±1 s.d. across them — measured, solid, capped.
† marks a placeholder. The other three have one seed each, so they carry ours' s.d. on that metric until their own seeds land. A lent interval is not a measurement,
which is why it is dotted and uncapped; do not read it as one.
Partial runs: ours seeds 0 and 1 stop at 45 and 44 tasks, CKA-RL at 41, so their forgetting and backward transfer are lower bounds.
